column2: Approval and rejection belong to the watcher prompt gate; the ladder cannot invoke them.
First-sight owner wake exists outside the row ladder; row timers are not applied to lanes.
Ring exists for silent workers only; errors need a distinct safe matcher and message.
Merge belongs to merge-on-green; the lane ladder cannot invoke it at the row timer.
Declared pauses bypass row actions and use their own recheck cadence.
